titulo.estudio: Une petite annonce : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A classified ad: vocabulary and forms

intro: Find the price, features and conditions in a simple ad. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Find the price, features and conditions in a simple ad. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: adjectives and quantities describe the item; « à vendre » signals a sale. In this passage, «vélo» means «bicycle».

frases.estudio: Le vélo est disponible à Tours pour quarante euros.
frases.alumno: The bicycle is available in Tours for forty euros.

frases.estudio: Le vendeur donne aussi un casque de taille moyenne.
frases.alumno: The seller also gives a helmet of medium size.
